record.field: Search for available trains between origin and destination stations on a given date.
Check remaining seat inventory and fare for a specific train number and travel class (1A, 2A, 3A, CC, EC, SL).
Create a train ticket reservation in Odoo with passenger details and calculate fare.
Confirm a draft/reserved ticket, allocate coach and berth numbers, and finalize booking.
Retrieve real-time reservation status, coach, and berth details for a given PNR.
Cancel an existing train ticket booking and return allocated seats to the inventory.
